title: Intelligence Bureau IB ACIO Gr-II/ Executive 2025 Final Result 2026 Out for 3717 Post
intro: Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) Intelligence Bureau (IB)  has Officially Released Final Result for the Post of Assistant Central Intelligence Officer Grade II / Executive Recruitment 2025 for 3717 Post..  Tier-II Exam Exam held on September 16-18, 2025 & Final Result Declared On June 3, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Final Result Now in the Given Link Below.
